stages.prompt: Run python3 scripts/content/ingest.py for new videos in input/videos, or scripts/content/import_video.py --content content/<content-id> --video input/videos/<file>. The video is moved, never copied.
Lock the approved visual sequence. Use python3 scripts/build_reel.py content/<content-id> only when every final_path exists. Report continuity issues at each cut.

Build one master audio timeline: dialogue, one continuous music/ambience bed, timed sound effects, approved native audio mixed beneath. Keep dialogue, UI sounds and music under real recorded/licensed control.
Ask the user to review the assembled Reel on a phone (9:16 framing, safe zones, softness, cuts, audio sync). Wait for their decision.
